s1.label: tube_pick
s1.reason: holding tube_1, tool 70 deg below level: the jaws stopped at 0.5 deg, squeezing at 1.50 N.m, 75 mm up
s1.what_happened: Physical success: tube_1 lifted from the rack, held 75 mm up (verdict OBSERVED: pick changes no reading).

s2.label: tube_place (well A)
s2.reason: tube_1 into well_1, and no reading changed: let go 31.6 mm above where it seats and let it fall
s2.what_happened: Physical success: released 31.6 mm above the seat and it fell into well A. Verdict FAIL only because POWER is still off, so no reading can change; tube_raw_1 reads 1 once the lid closes / power comes on.

s3.label: lid_close
s3.what_happened: Lid pulled over its top edge and down to 0 deg (lid shut); tube_raw_1 0->1.

s4.label: flip POWER up
s4.reason: toggle_1 switches lid (0 -> 1); also changed: power, tube
s4.what_happened: POWER on: ready, white ring, LCD '1000rpm  0:30'. Skill attributes the change to 'lid' because powering up reveals lid/tube readings at the same time.

s5.label: press TIME+
s5.reason: button_3 drives btn_time (0 -> 1 -> 0); also changed: time

s6.label: turn SPEED -60
s6.what_happened: SPEED dial -60 deg: 1000 -> 1900 rpm (verify.yaml's workflow expects 2000-2400 for the same turn; here it landed at 1900).

s7.label: press START
s7.reason: button_1 drives btn_start (0 -> 1 -> 0); also changed: run
s7.what_happened: START: running, blue ring, countdown started (LCD '1900rpm  0:38').

s8.label: press STOP
s8.reason: button_2 drives btn_stop (0 -> 1 -> 0); also changed: run
s8.what_happened: STOP: run stopped, back to ready, white ring, LCD '1900rpm  0:40'.

camera.note: MuJoCo free camera in the arm frame: behind and to the right of the arm (-x,-y), looking down at ~54 deg over the arm at the centrifuge and rack

notes: No harness run: driven directly through System 1's own sim skills via sim/tools/verify.py's Bench (the same runner as appliances/centrifuge/verify.yaml's workflow), Rev B, stock gripper, sensing current, no camera perception (sim truth part poses). run_id is null: no rav run folder exists; events.jsonl next to this file has step_started/step_finished in clip seconds (== sim seconds since t0). Before clip t=0 the rack cover and lid were set open to 105 deg as a fixture (as verify.yaml does); clip 0-1.0 s is the arm at home, no survey/scan. 0.6 s hold between steps, 1.5 s tail after s8. Real-arm skill names map to sim skills: tube_pick->pick tube_1, tube_place->place tube_1 into well_1 drop_mm 30, lid_close->hook_pull handle_1 angle 0, POWER->flip toggle_1 (no toward param in sim; it starts off so the flip turns it on), TIME+->press button_3, SPEED->turn dial_1 -60, START->press button_1, STOP->press button_2. Sim tubes have no coloured collars: tube_1 (rack position 2 from the verify workflow) stands in for the real red-collar tube. Rendered with MuJoCo's offscreen renderer (system-1/sim/viz.py), not the Console's Sim3D replay, so the look differs from clean_3d.mp4. Deterministic: two identical runs gave identical results and frame counts. Stills are the frame at each step's midpoint.
